chapter.verse: Pasian aw, nangmah hong bel ka hih manin kei hong hehpih in, kei hong hehpih in; siatna huihpi a ven’ mateng na kha limah kong bu ding hi.
A Sang Penpa Pasian’ tung, kei’ Pasian’ tung, kei’ adingin ama deihna a tungsak Pasian’ tungah ka ko hi.
Amah in vantung panin hong dawngin keimah hong hon ding a, amah in kei hong tuancilte maizumin koih ding hi. Pasian in a itna kip leh a thumanna hong lak ding hi.
Mihing tate, huaihamna tawh a netum humpinelkaite laizang ah ka om hithiat hi; amau hate in teipi leh thaltangte hi a, amau leite in namsau hiamte ahi hi.
Pasian aw, vantung’ tungah sangto lai in! Leitung khempeuhah na minthan’na omsak in!
Amaute in ka khe, thang hong siah uh hi; lungkhamin hong koih uh hi. Ka pai nading ah gum khat to uh a, ahih hangin tua sungah amaute mah kia uh hi.
Ka lung muang hi, Pasian aw, ka lung muang hi! La ka sa ding a, nakpi takin ka sa ding hi.
Ka tho ding hi! Harp lasakna leh laiza lasakna aw, tho un! Zingsang khuavak hong phong ning!
Topa aw, mite lakah nang tung lungdamna kong ko ding a, minamte lakah nangmah phatna ka sa ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh na itna kip in vantung ban a, na thumanna in meiipi banto hi.
Pasian aw, vantungte’ tungah sangto lai in! Leitung khempeuhah na minthan’na om sak in!
